sloka: अथ रविरवदन्निरीक्ष्य रामं मुदितमनाः परमं प्रहृष्यमाणः ।निशिचरपतिसङ्क्षयं विदित्वा सुरगणमध्यगतो वचस्त्वरेति ।। ६.१०७.३१ ।।
transliteration: atha raviravadannirīkṣya rāmaṁ muditamanāḥ paramaṁ prahṛṣyamāṇaḥ ।niśicarapatisaṅkṣayaṁ viditvā suragaṇamadhyagato vacastvareti ।। 6.107.31 ।।

translations.english: Then the sun, glad at heart and exceedingly rejoicing, standing amid the hosts of gods, learnt of the destruction of the lord of night-rangers, gazed upon Rama and spoke the word: "Make haste."
